title: marketplace-field-policy
description: Canonical per-field policy shape for config_contract.services.*.fields, shared across Stacker (author/publish), Install Service, and User Service (installer-facing resolution).
_notes: This schema governs one field entry under config_contract.services.<service>.fields.<FIELD_NAME> in stacker.yml.

mutability decides who controls the field's final value at install time: fixed (author's value only), editable (author's value is a default the installer can override), generated (system produces a fresh value per install).
type/length/min_length/values/signing_key/claims/alg only apply when mutability requires them (generated always needs a type; editable may optionally constrain via type+values).

A legacy stacker.yml using the old required/optional/secret plain string-list shorthand must still parse: required -> {mutability: fixed, required: true}, optional -> {mutability: fixed, required: false}, secret -> {mutability: generated, required: true, type: alphanumeric, min_length: 32}.

derived_jwt's signing_key is a "service.FIELD_NAME" reference to another field in the same config_contract that must itself resolve before this one (independent generated/editable fields resolve first).

length.description: Exact byte/char length. Used by hex/base64/uuid-adjacent fixed-length generators.

min_length.description: Minimum length. Used by alphanumeric generators and editable string constraints.

values.description: Allowed value set. Required when type=enum.

signing_key.description: "service.FIELD_NAME" reference to the field whose generated/resolved value signs this derived_jwt. Required when type=derived_jwt.

claims.description: JWT claims template for type=derived_jwt. Required when type=derived_jwt.

alg.description: JWT signing algorithm for type=derived_jwt. Required when type=derived_jwt.
